title: Licensee demographic and status reporting
rule_summary: Board licensees must update specified contact information and report specified name, criminal, disciplinary, or certification events within the applicable 14-day reporting period.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply change reporting requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing change reporting with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
